decision.observation: 9 mph, gear 1, timer 32:58.323, red X cleared, dots pale. Car sits just left of the gravel centre, nose up-frame; the road bends left then straightens past white posts, pines and a utility pole on the right, red/yellow foliage upper right.
decision.hypothesis: Rolling again from the stall. Starting on the left/inside of this left bend gives one more throttle second before the car drifts to the outside; 9 -> ~12 mph is the expected gain.
decision.memory: After a stall, two plain-W seconds are safe when the car is centred or inside; the third press is where right-edge drift and tree contact have typically occurred.
